element.reason: R2F-42c: compact team strip. v2 stacked one full-width Item per seat holder (about 500px at 1280/1440), which pushed the workflow canvas below the window. Each holder is now one small stock outline LinkButton in one wrapping line (same words; the one-line description moves to a stock Tooltip on the link), so the strip takes about 110px.
